methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $31M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Transportation (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 3 same-sector peers exist in Transportation, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
TerraDepth is a Series C-stage transportation company founded by Judson Kauffman and Josef Wolfel, having raised $31.1M to date. The transportation sector peer universe consists of 8 private companies including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Slate Auto, and ZeroAvia, with no public comparables identified. This fragmentation limits direct peer-based valuation approaches.

Valuation triangulation relied on stage-progression methodology, which proved the only applicable approach. Using total raised ($31.1M) as a proxy base value and applying a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x yields an implied valuation of $53M. Peer-median analysis was not executable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow transportation peer set—no combination of stage and valuation-tier filters produced the minimum three datapoints required for statistical reliability.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $45M to $61M, centered on a $53M median. This range reflects a 15% discount and 15% premium around the stage-progression point estimate to account for company-specific factors and execution risk not captured by the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of transportation-sector peers at matching development stage and the reliance on a standardized multiplier that may not reflect TerraDepth's specific unit economics, capital efficiency, or market traction. Direct revenue, growth, and burn-rate data would strengthen conviction in any specific valuation within this range.
